**[[2026 Mali attacks]]

*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**Talks between participants from the [[Taliban]] [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] in [[Afghanistan]] and [[Pakistan]] are held in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]] under a [[Track II diplomacy|Track 1.5 format]] in an effort to lower tensions between the two countries. [https://islamabadpost.com.pk/pak-afghan-talks-in-istanbul/ (''Islamabad Post'')] [https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/04/30/track-15-talks-begin-in-istanbul-to-help-reduce-pakistan-afghanistan-tensions (''Pakistan Today'')]

**At least 18 militants are killed in operations by Nigerian troops across [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-troops-kill-18-militants-northeast-operations-military-says-2026-04-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[World War II bomb disposal in Europe]]
**More than 1,000 homes are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] in [[Plymouth]], [[England]], following the discovery of an unexploded [[World War II]]-era [[Luftwaffe|German]] [[SC250 bomb]] on a building site. [https://news.sky.com/story/homes-evacuated-as-suspected-ww2-device-found-13538317?dcmp=snt-sf-twitter (Sky News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[61st Venice Biennale]]
**The jury of the [[Venice Biennale]] in [[Italy]] resigns ahead of the exhibition's opening, amid disagreement involving [[Meloni government|the government]] over [[Culture of Russia|Russia]]'s participation. [https://lethbridgeherald.com/entertainment/entertainment-news/2026/04/30/venice-biennales-international-jury-resigns-as-italys-government-opposed-russias-participation/ (CP via ''Lethbridge Herald'')]
*[[Reporters Without Borders]] reports that global [[press freedom]] has declined to its lowest level since [[World Press Freedom Index|the index]] began in 2002, with more than half of countries classified under severe conditions and the share of the world's population living in countries with strong press freedom falling to below one percent. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260430-press-freedom-at-lowest-level-in-25-years-rsf (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Tuapse oil terminal disaster]]
**Residents of [[Tuapse]] in [[Krasnodar Krai]], Russia, upload videos to [[social media]] appearing to show [[oil]] [[rain]]ing from the sky as authorities say the fire at the [[Tuapse oil terminal]] has now been extinguished after days of burning. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/30/europe/russia-tuapse-oil-refinery-strikes-pollution-intl-cmd (CNN)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/30/its-all-very-toxic (Al Jazeera)]
*[[July 2025 Central Texas floods]]
**[[Camp Mystic]] in [[Texas]], [[United States|U.S.]], withdraws an application to reopen during the summer in the wake of the floods last year, which killed 25 campers and two [[Camp counsellor|counsellors]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/camp-mystic-withdraws-application-open-summer-rcna342947 (NBC News)]
*Twenty people are killed after a jeep carrying pilgrims plunged off a cliff in [[Rolpa district]], [[Nepal]]. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/world/nepal-20-dead-in-jeep-crash-in-rolpa-district/ (''The Tribune'')]
*Eight people are killed in a collapse at a coal mine in [[Magadan Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/05/04/all-8-miners-confirmed-dead-after-coal-mine-collapse-in-russias-far-east-a92670 (The Moscow Times)]
*Five people are killed when a [[Cessna 421 Golden Eagle]] airplane crashes into wooden terrain in [[Wimberley, Texas|Wimberley]], [[Texas]], United States. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/five-killed-small-plane-crash-near-austin-2026-05-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Kampala school stabbing]]
**Thirty-eight-year-old Christopher Okello Onyum is [[capital punishment in Uganda|sentenced to death]] by [[hanging]] for the murders of four children at a nursery school on April 2 in [[Kampala]], [[Uganda]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3d2vzmgekjo (BBC News)]
*[[China]] announces it will ban the sale or renting of commercial [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] in [[Beijing]], while existing drone owners will also be required to register their devices with the [[Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau|police]], citing security concerns. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gv4dvngygo (BBC News)]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[President of Myanmar|president]] [[Min Aung Hlaing]] orders the remaining prison sentence of [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|deposed]] leader [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] to be served under [[house arrest]] and announces a one-sixth reduction of sentences for all prisoners, including Aung San Suu Kyi. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/aung-san-suu-kyi-moved-house-arrest-myanmar-6092826 (AFP via CNA)] [https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/world/archives/2026/05/01/2003856579 (AFP via ''Taipei Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Antiguan general election]]
**[[Antiguans and Barbudans]] vote to elect 17 members of the [[House of Representatives (Antigua and Barbuda)|House of Representatives]]. Incumbent [[Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda|prime minister]] and [[Antigua and Barbuda Labour Party|Labour]] leader [[Gaston Browne]], who is running for a fourth term, is being challenged by [[United Progressive Party|United Progressive]] leader [[Jamale Pringle]]. *[[2026 United States federal government shutdowns]]
**The [[U.S.]] [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]] unanimously approves a [[Bill (United States Congress)|bill]] passed by the [[United States Senate|Senate]] to fund the [[United States Department of Homeland Security|Department of Homeland Security]], the [[United States Secret Service|Secret Service]], the [[United States Coast Guard|Coast Guard]], [[Federal Emergency Management Agency|FEMA]], [[Transportation Security Administration|TSA]], and the [[Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency]] in an effort to end the 76-day [[Government shutdowns in the United States|government shutdown]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3352084/us-congress-votes-end-record-government-shutdown (AFP via ''SCMP'')] [https://apnews.com/article/homeland-security-shutdown-funding-trump-republicans-d377a15c40ad0f430983b6d918b24bb6 (AP)] [https://www.politico.com/news/2026/04/30/congress-ends-record-shattering-dhs-shutdown-00900777?gpp=DBAA (''Politico'')]
**The bill is signed by [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]], officially bringing an end to the shutdown. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce3pw5x3z54o (BBC News)] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-signs-homeland-security-funding-bill-ending-record-shutdown (PBS)]
*[[Arrest of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**The [[Brazil]]ian [[Brazilian National Congress|National Congress]] overrides a [[veto]] by [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] to reduce the sentence of former president [[Jair Bolsonaro]] for a [[2022–2023 Brazilian coup plot|coup]]-related conviction. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-congress-overturns-lula-veto-bill-cutting-bolsonaro-coup-sentence-2026-04-30/ (Reuters)]
